problem: It says film -2 and songs +3 "average to +1". The average of -2 and +3 is +0.5; +1 is their sum, so the wording is numerically wrong and a student may copy the wrong idea about averaging aspect scores.
fix: Reporting one total when aspects disagree: film -2 and songs +3 sum to +1 and hide the film complaint (the plain average would be +0.5).
